avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces buspirone concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout period if switching

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; both hepatically metabolized
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor liver function tests if history of use

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase buspirone levels and adverse effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased dizziness, drowsiness, or lightheadedness; consider dose adjustment if needed

caution_supplements.name: 5-HTP
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects may theoretically increase adverse event risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for serotonergic symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); use lowest effective doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases buspirone bioavailability and peak concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; effects persist for 24+ hours after consumption

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase buspirone absorption rate and bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Administer buspirone consistently with or without food; maintain routine for predictable levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, dizziness, and efficacy for anxiety symptoms. Assessment of liver function is advisable given CYP3A4-dependent metabolism and potential supplement interactions.
